description: Cobra in the riverside veterans park; Aerial Visuals carries the same fix under both a Breckenridge Minnesota and a Wahpeton North Dakota heading - the coordinate is on the Minnesota bank of the Red River so the aircraft is recorded here once
Cobra in the Fosston veterans memorial park; identity from Aerial Visuals; 68-15000 opens the FY68 AH-1G block
Cobra in the county veterans memorial park which honours McLeod County veterans back to the Civil War; identity from Aerial Visuals

Huey in the Long Prairie veterans memorial park; the same airframe is listed at a former Pillager Minnesota site in older directories - Aerial Visuals records the Pillager display as gone so it is recorded here only
Cobra in the Shakopee veterans memorial park; identity from the Aerial Visuals location dossier

Starfighter in the Valley City veterans memorial park; transferred here from the North Dakota Air National Guard display at Fargo; North Dakota State University is credited with the airframe in older directories but Aerial Visuals records it as no longer on the NDSU site; still mapped as an OSM historic=aircraft node in the current extract read September 2026
